title: TalkSy Complete English
tagline: From your first English word to confident communication.
description: The complete TalkSy program: a dependency-aware pathway from absolute zero (first alphabet and phonics) to advanced C1 communication, organised as ten sequential learning levels across a core language spine (stages 1-5) and four skills development tracks (stages 6-9), integrating into advanced communication (stage 10). Every lesson practises real reading, writing, listening and speaking; progress is measured by mastery, never by time spent.
contentLicence: All curriculum content is original educational material authored for TalkSy. No third-party course content is used.
